requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: Designed and implemented a frequency-domain acoustic beamformer for a 4-microphone endfire array in a behind-the-ear hearing-aid prototype, contracted by a Danish audiology startup.

requirements.note: This beamforming work is for an acoustic microphone array (hearing-aid application), not a radar/RF/comms array; quoted as described rather than judged for domain match, per the refuse-to-guess rule's instruction to let described substance speak.

lines.quote: Wrote and maintain the embedded signal processing firmware for Nordkom's current maritime radar: range compression, CFAR detection, and plot extraction in C on a TI C6678 multi-core DSP.
Built and maintain the production test framework in Python 3.10: approximately 6,000 lines controlling the RF test bench via SCPI, running automated acceptance tests, and generating per-unit reports.

Responsible for RF front-end calibration: R&S ZNB40 vector network analyser for S-parameter sweeps, noise-figure characterisation, and antenna pattern verification in the company's compact anechoic range.
MSc Applied Physics, Politecnico del Naviglio, 2014
T. Tanaka et al., "Sparse wideband DOA estimation via reweighted l1 minimisation," Proc. BALSIPCO, 2015.

Work performed under my Italian EU long-term residence permit (permesso di soggiorno di lungo periodo, granted 2019 after five continuous years of legal residence), which provides unconditional work authorisation across the EU.
All my professional work has been in English
I live in Oulu, have done since 2015, and I'm staying.
